sources.name: CoalNN
sources.scope: Full primary XML parsed; overview, multitask loss and weighted-breakpoint-BCE passages inspected.
sources.passage: CoalNN jointly predicts pairwise TMRCAs and recombination breakpoints. Methods use Huber regression and cross-entropy, with inverse-class-count weighted breakpoint BCE.

sources.name: SuperGlue
sources.scope: Full primary HTML parsed; abstract and §3.3 ground-truth correspondence/unmatched likelihood plus label construction inspected.
sources.passage: SuperGlue is trained in a supervised manner from ground truth matches. Some keypoints are labeled unmatched. The assignment negative log-likelihood trains both matching and rejection.

sources.name: Neural Relational Inference
sources.scope: Published ICML2018/PMLR abstract and bibliographic metadata only.
sources.passage: The model takes the form of a variational auto-encoder whose latent code represents the underlying interaction graph and whose reconstruction is based on graph neural networks.

sources.name: Structured Attention Networks
sources.scope: Full primary HTML parsed; introduction and §§2–3 latent graphical distribution, expected features and differentiable inference inspected.
sources.passage: Forward attention obtains an expectation of an annotation function through inference over exponentially many structures; marginals provide differentiable internal features.

sources.name: Domain-adaptive population-genetic neural networks
sources.scope: Primary XML parsed; abstract and ARG-inference-error/source-mismatch passages inspected.
sources.passage: In SIA the domain-adaptation framework compensates for ARG inference error; source-matched and target-matched simulation cases differ.
